correctness.rationale: Canonical simultaneous conjugation of whole flags (not merely subgroups) gives quotient cell numbers A5 (7,8,1) and S5 (17,49,41,7), with no inverted simplices since strict subgroup orders distinguish flag vertices. The exact source verifier constructs all 59 and 156 subgroups and validates every collapse pair and residual surface links. I independently enumerated all subgroups and chain-orbit cells and ran a different free-face ordering: A5 reduced to a connected 4-vertex, 4-edge circle after four pairs; S5 reduced to a connected (10,24,16) simplicial closed surface, every edge in two triangles, each vertex link a circle and Euler characteristic two. Thus the homotopy types S1 and S2 are independently corroborated even though the residual triangulations differ from the original (5,5) and (12,30,20) certificates. The complete original certificate was inspected.
